SELECT total_point FROM students WHERE (student_id = #{studentId} OR student_id = (SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) FROM students WHERE student_id = #{studentId} LIMIT 1)) LIMIT 1
SELECT COALESCE(total_point, 0) FROM students WHERE (student_id = #{studentId} OR student_id = (SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) FROM students WHERE student_id = #{studentId} LIMIT 1)) LIMIT 1
SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) FROM coupon_purchase WHERE (student_id = #{studentId} OR student_id = (SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) FROM students WHERE student_id = #{studentId} LIMIT 1))
SELECT DISTINCT stock_id FROM orders WHERE (student_id = #{studentId} OR student_id = (SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) FROM students WHERE student_id = #{studentId} LIMIT 1)) AND state IN ('체결', 'MATCHED')

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN content IN ('매수', 'BUY') THEN amount ELSE -amount END), 0) FROM orders WHERE (student_id = #{studentId} OR student_id = (SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) FROM students WHERE student_id = #{studentId} LIMIT 1)) AND stock_id = #{stockId} AND state IN ('체결', 'MATCHED')
SELECT name FROM stocks WHERE stock_id = #{stockId}

SELECT COALESCE( (SELECT o.price FROM stock_transactions t JOIN orders o ON t.buy_order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.stock_id = #{stockId} ORDER BY t.created_date DESC LIMIT 1), (SELECT publication_price FROM stocks WHERE stock_id = #{stockId}) )

SELECT COALESCE( ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN content IN ('매수', 'BUY') THEN price * amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN content IN ('매수', 'BUY') THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0)), 0) FROM orders WHERE (student_id = #{studentId} OR student_id = (SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) FROM students WHERE student_id = #{studentId} LIMIT 1)) AND stock_id = #{stockId} AND state IN ('체결', 'MATCHED')

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN content IN ('매수', 'BUY') THEN price * amount ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM orders WHERE (student_id = #{studentId} OR student_id = (SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) FROM students WHERE student_id = #{studentId} LIMIT 1)) AND stock_id = #{stockId} AND state IN ('체결', 'MATCHED')

SELECT COALESCE( ( ( SUM(CASE WHEN content IN ('매수', 'BUY') THEN amount ELSE -amount END) * ( SELECT COALESCE( ( SELECT price FROM orders WHERE stock_id = #{stockId} AND state IN ('체결', 'MATCHED') ORDER BY created_date DESC LIMIT 1 ), st.publication_price ) FROM stocks st WHERE st.stock_id = o.stock_id ) ) - SUM(CASE WHEN content IN ('매수', 'BUY') THEN price * amount ELSE 0 END) ), 0 ) AS profit FROM orders o WHERE (o.student_id = #{studentId} OR o.student_id = (SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) FROM students WHERE student_id = #{studentId} LIMIT 1)) AND o.stock_id = #{stockId} AND o.state IN ('체결', 'MATCHED') GROUP BY stock_id
